_what: How Denmark's nutrient and oxygen figures are actually produced. Every entry is a documented property of the measurement system, with its source. Collected because these facts are stated in technical annexes and stripped when the headline numbers travel.
_rule: Nothing here is inferred. Where a claim is our reading rather than the source's words, it is marked inferred:true.

overflow_reporting.source: Miljøstyrelsen, Datateknisk anvisning for regnbetingede udledninger (RBU), TA nr. DP02, version 4, gyldig 1. januar 2024
overflow_reporting.mass_method: modelled annual volume x a fixed national concentration (typetal)
overflow_reporting.note_on_flow: PULS records 'antal overløb' - the number of overflows. It records no flow rate, no peak and no threshold crossing, so a high-flow event that scours accumulated basin sediment cannot be distinguished from a small dilute one.

combined_overflow.provenance: NOVANA measurements of water from combined systems; one documented revision, 2019, when phosphorus was reduced by one third

separate_stormwater.provenance: Spildevandsforskning nr. 4, 1990, 'Bestemmelse af belastningen fra regnvandsbetingede udledninger'

typetal_nutrients_mg_per_l._note: These are annual-average figures, applied to an annual volume for load accounting. They are not event concentrations and cannot represent a first flush.

quality_control.procedure: If reported nitrogen divided by reported volume falls outside the interval, the data owner is contacted to correct the error.
quality_control.consequence: The check tests conformity to the assumed concentration, not accuracy. A genuinely high measured first-flush concentration would be flagged as a mistake.
exclusions: Dry-weather emergency overflows have a de minimis threshold below which they need not be entered in PULS at all
Sewage that surcharges onto the street and enters the stormwater system is classed as 'haendelig uheld' and not systematically accounted
Reporting is by the municipalities and utilities responsible for the discharge, with the agency filling in defaults for non-submitters

hazardous_substances.source: Miljøstyrelsen / DHI, 'Typetal for miljøfarlige forurenende stoffer i regnbetingede udledninger', januar 2022, based on NOVANA 2000-2020
hazardous_substances.catchments_selected: deliberately chosen to represent households and residential areas
hazardous_substances.excludes_basins: typetal cover only discharges 'uden forudgaaende rensning i form af fx filtrering eller sedimentation i regnvandsbassiner'
hazardous_substances.excludes_heavy_catchments: explicitly limiting for 'industriomraader og meget trafikerede veje'
hazardous_substances.counterpoint: the same programme reports the highest median metal concentrations in sludge from basins

diffuse_load.method: grab samples at fixed intervals, load computed as sum of daily discharge x linearly interpolated concentration
diffuse_load.documented_bias: In all three streams of the 2018 GUDP study, transport computed from grab samples was ALWAYS underestimated relative to intensive daily measurement. The authors suggest bias-correcting the national figures.
diffuse_load.storm_dynamics: high-frequency sensor data show nitrate diluting as discharge rises, then rising with a ~7 hour lag behind the flow peak, moving up to 0.5 mg N/l per hour
diffuse_load.estimator_pathology: In dry years such as 1996 and 2005 the calculated cultivation contribution comes out NEGATIVE - described in the literature as a meaningless result caused by the uncertainty in the assessment.
diffuse_load.agriculture_is_a_residual: measured-plus-modelled total, minus modelled point sources, minus modelled natural background

soft_bottom_fauna.consequence: The annual autumn die-off is never observed. It is measured only in its aftermath the following spring, once recolonisation has begun.

fedtemoeg_as_a_shore_condition.window_set_by: when people are on beaches and complain

koege_bugt.iltsvind_2023: Køge og Faxe Bugt blev der ikke registreret iltsvind
koege_bugt.iltsvind_2025: Køge Bugt og Faxe Bugt er der ikke registreret iltsvind i år
koege_bugt.interpretation: DCE's iltsvind is dissolved oxygen below 4 mg/l in bottom water, mapped in stratified basins. Køge Bugt is shallow and mixes readily, so it may never qualify while still having anoxic sediment, sulphate reduction and a putrefying shoreline. 'Not registered' is probably accurate and says nothing about whether the bay is dead.
koege_bugt.unresolved: Whether 'ikke registreret' means measured-and-absent or not-measured. Not established here.

national_volumes_m3_per_year.source: NOVANA point-source programme, via the MFS typetal report

load_trend_vs_outcome._what: The intervention and the outcome, side by side. Both series are published by the same institutions that publish the apportionment. Neither is disputed here; the point is that they are never plotted against each other.

nitrogen_load.series: Flow-normalised total nitrogen supply from Danish land areas to the sea
nitrogen_load.reported_by: DCE / Aarhus Universitet, annual NOVANA reporting; summarised at miljotilstand.dk
nitrogen_load.note: 'Flow-normalised' removes the year-to-year weather signal from the load series - which is itself worth noting, because the outcome series below is dominated by exactly that signal.
nitrogen_load.airborne_component: Atmospheric nitrogen to Danish sea areas was 59 kt in 2023 and is also roughly halved since 1990.

iltsvind_extent.series: Area of Danish inner waters affected by oxygen depletion, mid/late September
iltsvind_extent.reported_by: DCE, four notices per year (Jul-Aug, Aug-Sep, Sep-Oct, Oct-Nov)

observations.note: largest recorded; still the maximum of the series
largest in 20 years; second-largest September on record, exceeded only by 2002
nearly 50% larger than 2023; second-largest ever recorded, exceeded only by 2002
far smaller area, but early onset and a high severe fraction - over 40% of the affected area severely depleted in August

iltsvind_extent.caveat: The series is NOT monotonically worsening. Interannual variance is very large - 2025 was roughly a third of 2024 by area. That variance is itself the finding: extent is governed by the physics of the individual year, not by the slow trend in load.

load_trend_vs_outcome.the_juxtaposition: Land-based nitrogen supply is down about half since 1990. September oxygen-depletion extent in 2023 and 2024 was at or above the level of 1989, 2000 and 2002, when the load was roughly double. No trend in the extremes is detectable against a halved input.

competing_explanations.name: Legacy lag
competing_explanations.detail: LOOP catchments show 8-24 years between a management change and a detectable decline in stream nitrogen. 1990-2025 is 35 years - longer than the longest observed lag - so lag cannot carry the whole gap.

competing_explanations.name: Warming
competing_explanations.detail: DCE names bottom-water temperature above the long-term mean as a contributing factor. Warmer water holds less oxygen and respires faster. This has strengthened while nitrogen fell. It is not represented anywhere in a source apportionment.

competing_explanations.name: Loss of assimilative state
competing_explanations.detail: Eelgrass down 80-90% from historical extent; filtration capacity lost; benthos repeatedly killed; denitrification switching to DNRA under anoxia; a loose bed resuspending several times more often (see SEABED.md). The same load does more damage than it did in 1990. No term in any published account carries this.

karlstrup_kalkgrav._what: What is actually established about the condition of Karlstrup Kalkgrav, and when. Raised because a resident reported algal growth, odour, declining fish and accumulated plastic waste - none of which is visible in any monitoring series.

official_status.data_window: roughly 2014-2018 - the VP3 basis analysis; NOT current
official_status.ecological_basis: Assessed on the phytoplankton quality element only, from chlorophyll data.

what_is_not_measured: Not a designated bathing water, so it is outside the badevand sampling programme. The four bathing waters within 3 km are all coastal.
Chemical status has never been assessed - the field reads 'ukendt'.
No litter, plastic or macro-waste monitoring of any kind.
No odour, fish-kill or oxygen series.
The ecological assessment rests on one quality element, chlorophyll, in a window that ended around 2018.

clarity_claim.claim: 'den klareste på Sjælland' - the clearest lake on Zealand
clarity_claim.assessment: Uncited and undated. The page carries it forward but there is no evidence it was ever re-checked against a measurement. It should not be treated as a current statement of condition.

physical_setting.water_level: held about 4 m below sea level by a pump station
physical_setting.circulation: Wikipedia notes 'ringe cirkulation i søen' - poor circulation, with cold water immediately below a warm surface layer.
physical_setting.implication: A deep, poorly-circulating basin is the configuration that stratifies and goes anoxic under nutrient load. That is a reason NOT to use it as a receiving water, and it is independent of how clean it is now.

resident_report.reported: algal growth, some odour, fish dying out where there had been a fishing culture, and accumulated plastic waste from visitors
resident_report.status: UNVERIFIED HERE - and unverifiable from any published series, which is the point
resident_report.consistent_with: Local news reports of heavy summer visitor pressure and litter; the put-and-take fishery leased to Solrød Sportsfisker Klub Regnbuen; and the poor-circulation setting above.
